interpretation.comparator: Passive base, 58-column residual and endpoint readouts on each identical new controlled flow.
interpretation.fairness: Global MAE/MSE use the identical candidate-supported records in all three arms; unmatched counts remain explicit.
interpretation.endpoints: Same-car and 300-second responses remain separate targets; only true global transitions fit the global comparator.
interpretation.zero_duration: Zero-duration strata are separate. Decoded analytic zero does not establish learned slope improvement; inspect raw gains.
interpretation.randomized_groups: Descriptive assigned-action means across different states are not paired same-state counterfactual truth; no causal direction-success fraction is computed.
interpretation.scope: Four development days; no candidate controller deployment, full-day control benefit or automatic independent confirmation.
